searchLabel: Search titles, summaries and source excerpts
snapshotNote: Source versions checked at generation. This page does not watch files or refresh itself.
pendingNote: Project records need reconciliation. The host must resolve or explain outstanding conflicts before treating this understanding as settled.
intentQuestion: What are we trying to achieve?
noRecords: No records included in this group.
noSelection: Choose a record to explore its meaning and sources.
classificationNote: Host-organized category; original wording is preserved in Sources.
readOnly: Read-only view. Changes and approvals happen in the project conversation.
relationNote: Connections help navigation. Host-organized links are interpretations, not new project commitments.
noRelations: No connections included for this record.
sourceNote: Original excerpts from the checked files. Summaries are derived views, not verbatim user statements.
evolutionNote: Recorded decisions and supported changes. This is not a complete historical replay.
noEvents: No recorded changes included in this view.
noEventMatches: No recorded changes match this search.
beforeMissing: An earlier statement is not evidenced in this view.
currentRecordWarning: Linked records show the captured current understanding, not their full state at this historical point.
aboutText: This is a host-authored reading view of the selected project's records. Structure and source checks do not verify the meaning of every summary or prove product value.
noJavaScript: This snapshot requires JavaScript for navigation. Project files remain authoritative.
liveNote: Checks included source files while this page is open. Summaries are updated by the project agent.
currentNote: The included files match this summary. This does not verify every judgment or capture unrecorded conversation.
staleNote: Source files changed. This is the last published summary. Ask the project agent to refresh the TIE dashboard.
source_unavailableNote: An included source is missing or unreadable. The last summary remains visible; ask the project agent to reconcile the source.
projection_errorNote: The new projection is invalid or no longer matches its sources. The last valid summary remains visible.
disconnectedNote: File checks are not running in this page. Ask the project agent to reopen the TIE dashboard.
selectionRemoved: The selected record is no longer included in the new projection.
